about_the_game:
Neebota: 99 Fails is a 2.5D Metroidvania-RPG set in Zeebo's looping nightmare — a surreal world of grotesque monsters, deformed bodies, and buried memories.

  • Unlock Forms: Transform into Zeebo’s many twisted forms, each with unique abilities — smash through walls, move objects with your mind, and more.

  • Upgrade & Customize: Level up your character and powers to enhance strength, speed, reach, and traversal. Equip totems to evolve your playstyle and access deeper layers of the world.

  • Explore Freely: Discover a nonlinear, interconnected dreamworld full of secrets, side paths, and bizarre zones, where the line between monsters and environment gets blurred.

  • Face the Nightmare: Battle and face over 100 strange, shocking, and beautifully twisted enemies and bosses. Track them all in your evolving dream journal.

  • Unravel the Story: Meet NPCs in both the waking world and dreamworld, each with deep personal histories. Piece together Zeebo’s psyche and past through hidden clues scattered across Noobota.

  • Challenge Yourself: Complete the main campaign and unlock Adventure+ Mode, the ultimate singleplayer test.

  • Skill-Based Challenges: Try fast-paced trials built around mechanics like dashing, wall-jumping, and Smash-style target breaking.

  • Compete Online: Join frantic PvP races in any arcade challenge — beat friends and rivals on global leaderboards.

  • Endless Mode: Enter an endless multiplayer run where only the top 3 survive at each checkpoint. Last as long as you can for fame and glory.

  • Replay Value: With ever-changing challenges and rulesets, arcade mode keeps pushing your skill long after the main story ends.

Neebota is a new fantasy universe where beings wrestle with hope, fear, dreams, and self-discovery. Its dreamworld, Noobota, reflects the minds of its inhabitants — twisted, beautiful, and layered with meaning.

99 Fails is developed by indie studio Frying Jelly with a focus on building original IP and immersive worlds you can get lost in.
